caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different types of fine-tunning
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during full fine-tuning of the Whisper model across six epochs, comparing two model sizes: "tiny full" and "base full". The x-axis represents the training epoch, ranging from 0 to 6 with a linear scale and integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis represents WER, ranging from approximately 18 to 29, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The "tiny full" model is depicted by a gray dotted line with triangle markers, starting at a WER of 28.5 at epoch 0 and decreasing to 22.5 at epoch 6, with minor fluctuations, including a slight increase at epoch 2. The "base full" model is shown by a blue dotted line with triangle markers, starting at a WER of 21.5 at epoch 0 and steadily decreasing to 19.0 at epoch 6, with a small peak at epoch 2. Both lines show a general downward trend, indicating improved transcription accuracy over training epochs.
